Follow-up to a closed bug report: [1860] "View Reports" button missing on Report QM page https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1860-view-reports-button-missing-on-report-qm-page

This is a feature request to reintroduce a feature that was intentionally removed.

In open-beta `Build 1860`, the "View Reports" button was removed as an intentional change. However, this creates new issues:

1. Users can no longer see which reports are open & closed.

2. Users can no longer delete or "edit" open reports.

The first issue removes any transparency and signal indications of actions taken by the moderation team. This may be intended for privacy considerations. In the past, personally these signal indicators have been a great source of education for myself about how the community guidelines are enforced by the moderation team.

The second issue is greater. A report can be submitted once per category. If there is an error in the submitted report reason or the report itself, that report can no longer be deleted and/or resubmitted after deletion from the app.

This "intended change" to remove the "View Reports" button is a regression that removes some of the incentives to use in-app reporting and may push people like myself back to web ticket reporting for tracking/editing moderation requests, which I think is less streamlined than in-app reporting and the opposite intention of the [Trust & Safety Reporting Changes](https://help.vrchat.com/hc/en-us/articles/48406881241875-Trust-Safety-Reporting-Changes) since January 2026.
title: [1860] Keep or reintroduce the "View Reports" button on Report QM page
